lines.t: [distorted synth bass, cinematic percussion hits, atmospheric pads]
In the rain the window cracks
I was lost but you knew where I hid
Through the noise, through the sparks
You were calling to my heart
You are the light in the static
Rushing through my spirit like a wave
You are holy, breaking every boundary
Pulling me into Your endless grace
City lights on a thousand screens
Still Your presence burns in between
Every code line, every broken frame
You rewrite my soul with Your name
Through the noise, through the sparks
You were calling to my heart
You are the light in the static
Rushing through my spirit like a wave
You are holy, breaking every boundary
Pulling me into Your endless grace
On the pulse of the drum
You are the light in the static
